title: The two-sided trade window's one client slot (trade2) against the server's session machine
oneLine: Invite, waiting, open, ready, review, accepted, done-watch, receipt, failed: one client slot mirroring trade2.js invites and sessions.
topConcern: After a deploy or a seen drop the window survives as a phantom no button can close, hijacking bag taps and hiding chat until reload.
linked: P2-7 (party slot is cleared on state_sync)

title: The trade window's local edit state (staging mirror, gold sign, leave ask, big-gold ack, offer-changed notice, bag hand-off)
oneLine: Client-only phases beside the server snapshot: staged offer mirror, gold add/subtract, leave strip, big-gold ack, offer-changed notice.
topConcern: The offer-changed notice watches confirm flags, but two-stage edits reset ready flags, so a last-second swap after you readied shows no warning.

title: The trade receipt's beats (both piles, fold, toss to the bag, auto-close)
oneLine: Timed receipt: both piles, fold at 1.1 s, clones fly to the bag at 1.4 s, closed at 4.2 s.
topConcern: A weapon-only or pet-only trade always waits the full 1.5 s done-watch fallback before the receipt shows.

title: The legacy one-way gift trade (TradePanel offer, IncomingTradePanel accept/decline)
oneLine: Gift offer composed, relayed and held 2 min server-side, accepted or declined on an incoming card; only without caps.trade2.
topConcern: trade_offer skips the v2.3.3526 block filter, so a blocked player on an old or modified page can still raise the Incoming Trade card.

title: The duel challenge card and the accepter's optimistic duel flag
oneLine: Challenge card, accept/decline, the accepter's S._inDuel and lock, server challenge TTL and duel record, duel_end.
topConcern: Accepting an expired (2 min) or refused challenge sets S._inDuel forever: no duel_end comes, so diet, No man's land asks and taps stay wrong.

title: The kill-threat card (Ignore / Call Guards) and its countdown
oneLine: Threat card with a countdown, responded flag, skull marks; dormant while OPEN_PVP is false.
topConcern: An answered threat is hidden, not cleared, so _uiBusy stays true for the session (no quest dialogue, no tutorial banner) once PvP returns.

title: The party slot: invite card, roster strip, chip fold and two-tap leave/kick
oneLine: Party invite stub with identity-checked TTL, server roster renderer cleared on state_sync, folded chip and two-tap arms.
topConcern: The state_sync clear also drops an invite card the server still holds up to 60 s; a newer invite replaces an older one unannounced.

title: Legacy clans: invite card, membership cache, logo editor and the client-clocked clan war
oneLine: Clan create/join/leave cache, invite card, logo painting and a war each phone clocks itself; live only with clanparty off.
topConcern: Each war member's phone ends the war on its own clock and picks a winner from its own relayed score copy.

title: The life-skill guild quest ladder (which rung you are on)
oneLine: Per-skill ladder rung: the panel's device-local _guildProgress versus the server's guild_claims count, met only on a paid turn-in.
topConcern: On a second device the panel restarts at rung 0 and offers Claim for rungs already paid; the server refuses naming another rung, repeatedly.

title: The computer's chat composer (closed / composing, with a kept draft)
oneLine: C opens the composer; Enter sends and closes, Send stays open, Esc keeps the draft, the X clears it.
topConcern: chatInputValRef is described as the canvas loop's mirror but nothing reads it any more.

title: The legacy feedback window's fetch-per-filter and vote toggle
oneLine: Render-time fetch keyed by S._fbLastFilter, vote toggles, submit; only behind the hidden MenuBar.
topConcern: Votes are toggles keyed by a client-named playerId with no session check; a double-tap un-votes. Shared with the live dashboard page.

title: The legacy leaderboard window's fetch-per-tab cache
oneLine: Render-time fetch per tab into S._lbServerData with a peers fallback; only behind the hidden MenuBar.
topConcern: A late answer for the previous tab overwrites the data under the current tab and is sorted by its key.

title: The quest giver's dialogue flow over the predicted quest record
oneLine: Talk, offer or claim, Rewards claimed, next quest; the phone predicts accept and turn-in payouts before the worker answers.
topConcern: Turn-in refusals for unmet objective, non-active quest or missing XP skill send no echo, so the predicted payout and next quest stand uncorrected.

title: NpcDialogue's line pager
oneLine: Index over authored speech chunks, reset when the text changes, optional locked backdrop and action button.
topConcern: The reset runs in an effect, so a new shorter speech can render one frame on the old index with last=true.

title: The quest banner: one slot, a 3-deep queue, per-kind hold times
oneLine: QUEST ACCEPTED/COMPLETE/REWARD/WELCOME banner; player-caused preempt, system notices queue, waits behind loading screens.

title: The achievement banner's moments queue
oneLine: Big achievements queued (max 6, dropped after 120 s), each shown 3.2 s once the world and icon are ready.

title: The stale-build watch and its New version available banner
oneLine: Polls version.json; on a mismatch stops, reloads on pre-game screens, else shows a dismissible banner.
topConcern: Once dismissed the watch is already stopped, so a later deploy in the same session is never announced (deliberate).

title: The player card's own sub-states (card / Inspect card, report row, async portrait)
oneLine: Panel-local card/profile toggle, report reason row, generated portrait with an alive guard; reset by unmount.
topConcern: reportSent is per mount, so reopening the card offers Report again (deliberate; the worker limits).

title: Friend and block relationships: a stale React copy the live player card reads and writes back
oneLine: friendsList/blockedList seeded once from localStorage; dashboard and server friendships change underneath; the card shows and rewrites the stale copy.
topConcern: Block P on the dashboard, then block Q on a player card: the card writes its old copy plus Q, silently unblocking P's requests.
linked: src/game/chatMute.js (mutes subscribe, the model to copy)

title: Diego's shop drawer: selection, debounced quote, busy guard, list re-asks and the rejoin reset
oneLine: Select, quote (140 ms debounce), busy, settle; bag key list re-asked every 700 ms; reset on rejoin.
topConcern: Anyone's sale broadcast clears busy, and the button's total is never re-quoted when his pile moves, though settlement takes no expected price.
